ModMetaData.name: Harmony 3 Strict Binding Compat (local)
ModMetaData.author: sammael
ModMetaData.description: Local stop-gap fixes for RimWorld 1.7 (Harmony 3, UnityStubs). Remove each one when the mod it covers is fixed. Same list as the README on GitHub. Every C# fix fingerprints the method it touches and logs a red error when that mod updates; XML fixes fail loudly the same way. - Biomes! Caverns (Caveworld Flora): wild fungus colonies regrow (each removed mushroom lowers its colony's count; on load counts are reset to the live mushrooms). - Biomes! Caverns (Caveworld Flora): wild fungi mouseover shows growth again instead of "Brightbells)". - Biomes! Caverns: strips the equipment nodes from BMT_ResourceBlueCrystal ("is equipment but has no verbs or tools"). - Loading Progress: its startup profiler no longer races during parallel XML loading (a mod's defs could fail to load and crash the game into a ModsConfig reset). - Loadout Compositing + Better Workbench Management: per-tag bills get the "count pawns away / on caravan" option back (BWM's new Debug build broke LC's transpiler). - Better Workbench Management: its bill options no longer overlap the "Use global style" dropdown (vanilla classic mode or Style Change Anytime). - Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage: animalfeeders (strigoi) drink animal hemogen packs on their own, like regular packs, when no prisoner or regular pack is available. - Hospitality: Vending machines (personal tweak): the powered vending machine draws 100 W and keeps stored items frozen while powered. - MSS Tweaks and Fun: haunt portraits no longer saved upside down on 1.7/Vulkan. - MSS Tweaks and Fun: VFE Pirates Buckoneer culture patch remapped to the VFEP_Mercenaries faction. - Eternal Pawns: faction leaders, leader kinds and warcasket wearers stay out of the veteran draw; MustBeCapableOfViolence honoured. - Hospitality: visitors in warcaskets skip the arrival re-gear (casket pieces re-locked) and keep their casket helmet on. - Hospitality: diagnostic only, logs which think node puts a guest with a claimed bed on the floor. - Giddy-Up 2: dismounted caravan animals keep their travel/follow target, so the caravan arrives and leaves. - Vanilla/unknown: a caravan guard holding a trader kind counts as the Trader (dismiss works, caravan exits). - VEF (MVCF): multi-verb weapons use the weapon's own accuracy/cooldown when the verb sets none; duplicate stat rows hidden; Range row fixed. - VEF: verb range factor applied to the result instead of the shared verb def (no stuck ranges). - Simple Leadership: leaders only join raids whose points cover them. - Sensible Bed Ownership: reservation prefix skipped for beds with no map. - Skilled Refueling: Harmony 3 unchecked binding for its mistyped __instance patch. - Basic Traits: "TraitHediffApplier: Processing pawn" debug spam removed. - Triumphant Research: shows the full unlock list instead of a blank window. - Too Many Mods: 22 lowercase "Defs/thingDef[" xpaths fixed (Rimsenal items). - Rimsenal Faction Pack - Spacer: no second style comp on the mech commander helmet, Dresser and EndTable. - ReGrowth plant patches: duplicate wild plant records removed from biomes (world-gen Landmarks/Mutators steps). - Vanilla: no needs while no world exists (quest pawns built before the world loads). - Vanilla/unknown: trade ship slave also saved as a world pawn no longer loads twice.
